title: RootCeremonyEvidenceProduction
description: Public evidence record of the BANZA offline root-key ceremony under the 2-of-3 custody model. Captures who was present, which PUBLIC keys were produced, the custodian signatures, the content hashes, the recovery-test result, and the witnesses. The real ceremony happens OFFLINE on the custodians' own computers; this record contains PUBLIC material only. NO secret fields exist here — no private key, no seed, no mnemonic, no passphrase, no recovery secret. Any such field is FORBIDDEN and makes the ceremony INVALID (M2_ROOT_CEREMONY_INVALID_FORBIDDEN_PRIVATE_KEY_MATERIAL). Missing offline evidence yields M2_ROOT_CEREMONY_BLOCKED_BY_OFFLINE_EVIDENCE_GAP; a missing/failed recovery test yields M2_ROOT_CEREMONY_BLOCKED_BY_RECOVERY_TEST_GAP. Status is computed by applying the rules stated in this contract. The rules are the definition; no implementation of them is.
_authority: Root Trust Ceremony (2-of-3 offline custody, docs/governance PKI trust model)
_boundary: Root trust for the BANZA open financial protocol. The root does NOT authorise payment services, does NOT create operators, does NOT issue licences, does NOT move/settle/hold funds, and does NOT replace operator regulatory authorisation. BANZA remains an open financial protocol; PSPs/banks/authorised operators are separate entities that implement it.

ceremony_id.description: Identifier of this offline root-key ceremony.

date.description: When the offline ceremony was conducted.

custodians_present.description: The independent custodians present. At least 2 of 3 are required for a valid ceremony.

public_keys.description: Root PUBLIC keys produced during the ceremony. Public material only.

signatures.description: Custodian signatures produced during the ceremony. Public material only.

hashes.description: Content hashes recorded during the ceremony (metadata, delegations, transcript).

recovery_test_result.description: Outcome of the offline recovery test performed during the ceremony. See root-recovery-test.production.schema.json. No secret content.

performed.description: Whether a recovery test was performed. Must be true or the ceremony is BLOCKED_BY_RECOVERY_TEST_GAP.

all_custodians_restored.description: Whether every custodian successfully restored from their encrypted backup during the test.

public_keys_match_after_restore.description: Whether the restored public keys matched the originally generated public keys.

witnesses.description: Independent witnesses who attest to the ceremony. Names/roles only — no secret material.
